head: codex/fix-kpmo-proof-gate-path-20261024
title: Require verified proof handoff before terminal recovery
body:
## Summary

- Bind Assurance classification and KPMO proof handoff to exact workflow paths.
- Download and validate the exact proof artifact ZIP, verify its archive and receipt digests, and admit credentialed recovery only for a fully bound VERIFIED_PASS receipt.
- Keep the recovery receipt non-authorizing; preserve reservation state and Production/Public/G5 HOLD boundaries.

## Validation

- Terminal proof admission: 11 tests passed, including NOT_APPLICABLE, digest, and lineage rejection.
- Assurance completion and recovery admission: 26 tests passed.
- Post-merge recovery workflow: 13 tests passed.
- Success-authority gate validator: passed.
- Workflow mutation-boundary validator: passed with no findings.

The original reservation remains untouched until a naturally triggered, verified terminal receipt closes it.
